plan.title: Single-stage RFQ empty award option validation

steps.note: Open the Single Stage creation screen where the RFQ configuration drawer is available.
Apply the required tenant configuration that prevents vendors from being added during event creation.
Apply the required read-only ceiling-price configuration.
Open and attempt to save the RFQ configuration without supplying an award option, exercising the required radio-group validation.
Assert that the configuration window shows an inline validation message after the empty award option is submitted.
